::: {#exm-normal-vector-uphill}

#### Stepping along the normal vector

Let $\modmemf{\vx} = 2x_1 + x_2 + 1$ as in @exm-level-sets-linear, so $\vcoef = \tp{(2, 1)}$ and $\norm{\vcoef}^2 = 5$.
At $\vx = \vzero$, $\modmemf{\vzero} = 1$.
A step of $t = 1$ along $\vcoef$ lands at $\tp{(2, 1)}$, where $\modmemf{\tp{(2, 1)}} = 4 + 1 + 1 = 6 = 1 + 5$.
A step along the [unit vector](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-unit-vector) $\vcoef / \sqrt{5}$ raises $\modmem$ by $\sqrt{5} \approx 2.24$,
while a step along $\tp{(1, 0)}$ raises it by only $2$.

:::
